newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 5.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Monday morning:
** Key earnings announcements expected from leading private aluminium maker Hindalco Industries and term lender Industrial Credit & Investment Corporation of India
** Finance Minister P. Chidambaram says government to release paper on cost of subsidies on "non-merit goods" to the exchequer, the Times of India newspaper says
He says 50 percent cut in these subsidies would wipe out the fiscal deficit

** Reliance Industries is trying to privately place five-year non-convertible debentures worth 1.0 billion rupees at a fixed coupon of 14.5 percent payable semi-annually, the Economic Times newspaper reports
** Foreign exchange reserves gain only by $74 million during the week ended April 22 against an increase of $691 million in the week ended April 4, the Business Standard reports
** The Tatas will hike their stake in Tata Power to 19.87 percent, from the current 15.76 percent, the Economic Times says
** Utility vehicle and tractor maker Mahindra and Mahindra Ltd says its board will meet on June 10 to finalise accounts for the year ended March 31, 1997

** Bombay's benchmark stocks index fell 23.86 points, or 0.62 percent, to 3801.71 in the week ended Friday. The index .BSESN closed 39.40 points, or one percent, down on Friday on worries about a possible oil price hike and a corruption scandal in the government.
